title: A cantilever's first frequency
model: a 100 x 10 x 10 mm steel cantilever (E 210 GPa, 7850 kg/m^3) clamped at x = 0; 2.5 mm elements

f1.source: Euler-Bernoulli: f = (1.8751^2 / 2 pi) sqrt(E I / (rho A L^4)) (Blevins, Formulas for Natural Frequency and Mode Shape, 1979, ch. 8, the clamped-free beam)
f1.reason: Euler-Bernoulli leaves out shear and rotary inertia, which at L/h = 10 lower the first frequency by about half a percent, and the clamp's hold of the root, which raises it a little; the mesh error at 2.5 mm is under 0.1 %
